issues.legal_issue: The Court should decline discretionary appellate intervention where tax authorities and the tribunal summarily reject a plausible explanation for funds without examining its proposed sources.
material_facts: The assessment included a substantial credit in the books of a family business and amounts spent on property, treating them as income from undisclosed sources.
The taxpayer explained that the business funds came partly from remittances earned by a family member in an overseas business and partly from income from family agricultural property.
The proposed sources were capable of investigation, but the assessing officer did not examine them; the appellate authorities and tribunal also rejected the explanation without inquiry.
The Commissioner appealed by special leave after the High Court answered a question referred in a tax matter in favour of the taxpayer.
issues.conclusion: The Court declined to exercise its discretionary jurisdiction, held that the case was not fit for intervention, and dismissed the appeal with costs.
issues.legal_principle: The Court considered whether justice required intervention in its discretionary jurisdiction under Article 136 of the Constitution. Because the explanations were capable of examination but had been arbitrarily rejected without inquiry, it declined to address the technical questions about the High Court’s authority or its treatment of the Tribunal’s findings. The proceeding arose from a reference under Section 66(2) of the Indian Income-tax Act, 1922. The Supreme Court relied on no earlier cases in reaching its disposition.

rule.if: tax_reference_special_leave_appeal and plausible_source_explanation and sources_not_investigated and reviewing_bodies_rejected_without_inquiry

predicates.tax_reference_special_leave_appeal: The proceeding was a special-leave appeal from a judgment answering a question referred in a tax matter.
predicates.plausible_source_explanation: The taxpayer attributed the funds to proposed sources that were capable of examination and were not prima facie absurd.
predicates.sources_not_investigated: The assessing officer did not investigate the proposed sources of the funds.
predicates.reviewing_bodies_rejected_without_inquir: The appellate authorities and tribunal rejected the explanation without examining its merits.

issues.definition: When a special-leave appeal arising from a tax reference concerns a plausible source explanation that the assessing officer did not investigate and the reviewing bodies rejected without inquiry, the appeal is dismissed.
